content: Sum Yaru auho Konilias öngkung imongo mata inogoc
Oro Römphon tawa amna au mano Konilias yu Sisaria taun wocin ididoc. Yu woi tawa amna torop 100 worochon dugo idi-doc. Tawa amna torop worochon mano woi ‘Italiahon’ ihoroc yongidung.

Konilias yu bumbumyi nanohon toropdec mahong yu ino orin nip orugi yu Kopotoroc anggendingmuya yong moröng imongidung. Konilias yu amna gipmo muno, yu owi amna urocima manomanoha ogepma sinom tong fat yengidoc. O yu woi bongono bongono Kopotoroc dönac inongidoc.
Oro bongono auho tri kilok dobocsisicha Koniliasho duc itu tongmuna tuctugo sinom Kopotorochon sum yaru agoc. Auna sum yaruho yuot engmuna inogoc, “Konilias!”

Ihoroc yuna Konilias yu botongga among fihic tongo inogoc, “Moröma tingting sinom oro.” Ihoroc inuna sum yaruho inogoc, “Gochon dönac orongi o gocho owi amna urocima tong fat yengitarocmaha woroc wömai Kopotorocho yangmuna gocha irot ogep kombihac.
Worocha goc amna au inong muya yu Yöpa taun ongmuya amna au mano Saimon woroc yangat tepnung. Saimonthon mano auma wömai Pita ihoroc yongidang.
Yu wömai bot godibo tobic tobic amna Saimon yuho bucin itac. Böcno wömai top tan itac.”

Sum yaruho Konilias mata ihoroc inongga ongina Konilias yu youp amnanin yai orin tawa amnano tungu yu inong yuna ebung. Tawa amna wo yu woi ihorocgon Kopotoroc yong moröng imongidoc. O yu Koniliasho bucin ididoc.
Yu ehuya Koniliasho yapmu yudec öngkupacma worochon fatno inongo inong muuna Yöpa taun onggung.
Pita yu itu togoc

Oro Koniliashon youp amnaniho ongga uyapdec dungmuya kembotsumgon ongga ap mano Yöpa taun ongfom togung. Ong fom togungan bongono wocin sinomu wömai Pitaho dönac yocyocha böchon barandadec ögoc. Baranda wömai böc koroc woce idoc.
Woce itmuna worec imuna nacno nocnocha kombigoc. Tuna nacno abiho tong arangarang tongidiya yu duc itu togoc.
Duc itu tongga foringga agocmai mom ang tuna yapmu au boru moröma simbang worocho ohong tohogoc. Yapmu auho bungötno awano munodec sogito idiya ohong tohongga gurocdec ohogoc.
Ohongga worocho irotnon wömai arap kiapmo ihono ihono orin yup orin gorom yocma worocho ambarac wocin wodörec tongga idung.
Boru worocho ohuna duc inggun auho öngkongo Pita inogoc, “Pita, goc idongga wo dongga nahi.”
Mata ihoroc öngkuuna Pitaho soroc yongga yogoc, “Moröma, nocu wo manait. Obuguingon ida nocu manomano bongbong sicsicyi betni ihorocno manongidot.”
Ihoroc inuna duc inggun auho wönggon inuna bongo yai idoc, “Manomano wo wömai Kopotorocho tongsac togoc. Worocha gocu ‘woi betni’ yongo yirocha,” ihoroc inogoc.
Oro yapmu worocho bongo anfi Pita ihoroc öngkung imongga wönggon momdec ögoc.
Uuna Pita yu ‘itu worochon foro wo yaö’ yongo kombic kombic youp koböc tongga idina Koniliashon youp amnaniho Saimonthon böcha inongacgon tong tengga simbudec wocin engkubung.
Woce engkungo mamboda yogung, “Saimon, mano auma Pita, yu ngocin itacha muno?”
Ihoroc mambuya Pita yu abe itu togocmahon foroha kombic kombic youp tongo idina Yaruho inogoc, “Kombihi, amna anfi yu gakaha ebang.
Worocha goc idongga ohongga yahi. Gocu yuot onggonga kombingbanac tirocha. Muno noc nakabuc yu inongmuaya ebang.”
Ihoroc inuna Pita yu ohongga amna woroc yaun feuya inogoc, “Amna yabing tonggungma nocu ngo. Sonu foro yaha sinom ebang oro?”

Ihoroc inuna yuho inogung, “Tawa amnahon dugo Konilias yu non ninong muuna ebamon. Yu woi bumbumyi nanohon toropdec mahong yui amna nongnongo ogepma. Yu Kopotorocha gending imongitac. Worocha tongga Yuda nano ambaracho yu anggending-idang. Oro yudec wömai sum yaru auho öngkung imongo ‘Pita inong wodingga yuhon mata kombihi’ yongo inogoc. Wo inogocmaha yu non ninong muuna ngo ebamonma.”
Ihoroc inuya Pitaho amna wo inuna bucin öngmuya woce dubung. Duuya sa isuna Pitaot amna worocot yu onggung. O Yöpa sa wocinma kombing tobic tobic amna au yu worocot kondong onggung.
Pita yu Koniliasho bucin idoc
Yu ongga kumbong diuna uyapdec dubung. Duuya sa isuna kembotsum uyap ongga Sisaria bucin ongkubung. Woce ongkuuya Konilias yu urop niporugi inuna ambaracho engsuran tongga yuha torengga idung.
Tuya Pita yu bucin uuna Koniliasho engmuna Pitahon orungo forodec aring mögoc mahong
Pitaho yu sogito tun idonguna inogoc, “Goc idongoi, nocu amna nucagon”.
Ihoroc inuna Pitaho yu mata inun ganun toctocho böc ganang ögomoroc. Öngmunya Pitaho yagocmai owi amna koböcma sinompho suran tongga idung.

Woce idiya Pitaho yu inogoc, “Sonu urop kombingdeang, Yuda amnaho bumbumyi nanoho bucin öcöchahu o yuot youp kondong toctocha wömai bongbong morö itac. Wohong Kopotorocho noc tuctugo sinom ingoroc nindagoc, nocu amna au betni yongo angsaha yitha.
Worocha tongga nocho mamboc soni mafodiit. Muno, nocu domdomgon epat. Sonu nanuya kombiwa, sonu ‘nocho ting towa’ yongo nanong wodiang?”

Ihoroc yuna Koniliasho inogoc, “Sep youp toctoc awanomuno urop bödengina tri kilok dobocsisi bongono wocin nocho böcnan itmaina dönac youp togot. Dönac youp tongo edeya karupgon amna auho yangamnadec öngkungga idoc. Böruno wömai yaguno möcmöcni sinom.
Ihoroc öngkung namongo nanogoc, ‘Konilias, Kopotorocho gochon dönac urop kombigoc. O ihorocgon gocho amna urocima tongfat yengitarocma woi kombingbödehac.
Worocha goc amna inong muiya Yöpa sae ongmuya Saimon inong yonung. Yuhon mano auma Pita. Yu woi bot godibo tobic tobic amna mano Saimon yuho bucin itac. Böcno top tan itac.’

Sum yaruho ihoroc nanogocmaha tongga nocu karupgon amna au inongmuaya gocot onggung. Tuya gocu kurömna sinom eparoc. Non ngo ambarac engga Kopotorocho yangamin itmanaina ‘Morömaho yaö mata ninoc ninochon ganogocma woroc kombina’ yongo ngo engsuran tamon,” Koniliasho Pita ihoroc inogoc.
Pitaho Koniliasho bucin fatmata ogepma yogoc
Pitaho Koniliashon mata wo kombingga ingoroc yogoc, “Boinno sinom, önga noc kombihat, Kopotoroc yu amna torop tunguhagon ma-kombingitac.
Muno sinom, bumbumyi nanohu o Yuda nanohu, owi amna ambarac toroc kiap nongnongo tongidangma o yu anggending-idangma yu wömai Kopotorocho yang banangitac.
Kopotorocho Israel nano irot guchon fatmata ogepma nimogocma wo sonu urop kombingdeang. Yesu Duic yu owi amna ambarachon Morömano. Yuha tongga non Kopotorocot irot tungu ididamon.

O ihorocgon sonu urop kombiang, Jöntho Galili gurocin itmuna owi amna ‘irot soni ibararut’ yongo yamuc gupguphon mata yong fandat tonggoc. Tuna menon sa guroc danong toroc kiap inobaracgon öngkung tonguya Yudia gurocin bödegoc. Worochon fatno sonu urop kombingdup tang.

O ihorocgon sonu urop kombiang, Kopotorocho Yesu Nasaretma guram tongo Kunkun Yaru orin gesö moröma sinom yudec sing imogoc. Sing imuna Yesu yu böcsa danong itongmuna owi amna ogepma sinom tongfat yengidoc. Kopotorocho yuot idocmaha tongga yu dogu kopothon gesö tohongga owi amna doun orokuya orung idung.

Manomano wo wömai nontho yangbödegomon. Yesuho Yudia gurocinthu o Yerusalem taun woce youp inobarac tongidocma woroc ambarac nonu yangbödegomon. Yu youp inobarac sinom tongidoc mahong Yuda nanoho yu ep goröcdec wuya omboc.
Omuna sep youp toctoc anfi idina Kopotorocho yu tun wekuna owi amna koböcmaho yu agung.

Wohong owi amna ambaracho wömai yu magung. Muno, Kopotorocho amna torop eragocma nonihogon wömai Yesu agomon. Kopotorocho ‘nontho Yesuhon fatno yong morögi-nahamon’ yongo non eragoc. Tuna Yesuho omocdecma wekongga idonggocanu wömai nonu yuot itmanaina nacno yamuc kondonggon nagomon.

Nacno nongmanaina Yesuho youp mata ingoroc ninogoc, ‘Son muyu ongmuya owi amna nochon foro inong tuctuc tongo ingoroc inongitnung. Kopotorocho nocgon soworeuna nocho owi amna omimahu o wecimahu yu ambarac mata youpdec fohong yungga matano angsoworengga ya bödeangoc.’ Yesuho youp mata ihoroc ninogoc.

Kombiarut, Kopotorochon yong tuctuc amna ambaracho Yesuha ingoroc yong tuctuc yogung, Owi amna ambaracho yu kombing tobing imongidangma yu wömai Kopotorocho yang banangga turongono doun bödenahing.’ Pitaho ihoroc yogoc.
Kunkun Yaruho fodip sinom bumbumyi nanodec ohogoc
Oro Pita yu fatmata ogepma yongga idina wohogon Kunkun Yaruho owi amna fatmata kombigungma yudec ohogoc.

Ohuna Yuda amna Pitaot kondong ebungma yu kombigungmai, bumbumyi nanoho duc inggun foro au yongmuya Kopotoroc yong moröng imogung. Woroc angmuya soroc yongga yogung, “Mayain, Kopotorocho bumbumyi nano yangbanango Kunkun Yaru yudec sing imogoc,” ihoroc yogung.

Yuya Pitaho yogoc, “Yaarut, non Yuda nanoho Kunkun Yaru osucgon sogidomonma worochon torocgon wömai owi amna ngo yu Kunkun Yaru önga sogiang. Worocha tongga nontho yu yamuc gupgupha bongbong masing imonin.

Muno, yu muyu yamuc guarut.” Pitaho ihoroc yuna owi amna torop wo yu Yesu Duichon madec yamuc gubung. Tongo mit yu ‘Pita sep youp toctoc au noniot itun’ yongo yu inong ac togung. Tuya Pitaho yuot wocin idoc.
